description: List past/ongoing meetings for one or more teams (Relay connection), newest first. `teamIds` is required. `meetingTypes` defaults to all four (retrospective, action, poker, teamPrompt). `before` bounds the window (defaults to now); paginate older with `after`. Parabol GraphQL: viewer.meetings. Requires MEETINGS_READ.

after.description: DateTime cursor — return meetings before this ISO timestamp (older page).

before.description: DateTime upper bound (ISO). Defaults to now.

meetingTypes.description: Meeting types to include (MeetingTypeEnum). Defaults to all four.

teamIds.description: Team ids to fetch meetings for (required).

name: list_meetings
title: List meetings (history)
